text: Coming down on the deck like gravel out there. Manu Chao calls it paradise. Rainin In Paradize. From in here, dry, with coffee, he's not wrong.
Rain drumming on the wheelhouse roof and Gerrit pressed against the glass, wanting in. Coldplay, Rainy Day. [to Gerrit] Fine. Mind the records.
Not a cloud anywhere. Coldplay, Rainy Day, played on a clear one, just to keep the sky honest.
Black sky, the wind howling in the rigging, the anchor chain grumbling. Creedence, Bad Moon Rising. [dryly] Thank you, John Fogerty. Very helpful.
Clear sky, stars all the way down to the water. Creedence Clearwater Revival, Bad Moon Rising. I've looked. No sign of trouble up there.
Dark out here, except the lighthouse, sweeping past every few seconds. Creedence, Long As I Can See The Light. [quietly] I can. I'm fine.
Sun off the water so bright I'd be steering by memory, if we weren't at anchor. Manfred Mann's Earth Band, Blinded by the Light.
Clear night, every star out over the boat. Foo Fighters, The Sky Is A Neighborhood. Gerrit's asleep in his crate. The rest of the neighbours are up.
My breath's fogging the wheelhouse glass and I'm wearing three jumpers. Cage The Elephant, Cold Cold Cold. Opa's the warmest thing aboard, and he knows it.
Cold evening, and the burner's on for warmth more than cooking. Franz Ferdinand, This Fire. Hands round the mug, everybody.
The Zeemeeuw's rolling like a barrel and the anchor's holding. Just. Capital Cities, Safe And Sound. Say it with me.
Every window in the wheelhouse open, and the mug's gone warm all on its own. The All-American Rejects. Sweat.
